card.name: Class meeting times in course listings
card.fires_on: Digits, colons and dashes inside a clock-time range such as 10:30-11:20. The setting is a university course schedule with SLN numbers and day codes like MTWTh.

modes.label: Inside the time range
modes.description: Digits, colon or dash within a class meeting time after day letters like MTWTh.
modes.example: M S 211: Climate Change (5) NW SLN 10612 MTWTh 10:3<<0>>-11:20 – F

modes.label: Colon or dash in the time
modes.description: The punctuation between hours and minutes, or between start and end times.
modes.example: S 211: Climate Change (5) NW SLN 10612 MTWTh 10:30<<->>11:20 – F Quiz

card.plain: It fires on the numbers and punctuation of class meeting times in a university course timetable.
